outcome: Preparedness for labor and baby care
cohort: 303 pregnant clients attending the South Community Birth Program (SCBP) in Canada, an interprofessional, collaborative, primary care maternity program
finding: Interprofessional group perinatal care was comparable to interprofessional individual care in terms of all measured outcomes, including mode of birth, gestational age at birth, infant birth weight, breastfeeding rates, pregnancy knowledge, preparedness for labor and baby care, client satisfaction, and rates of adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Mode of birth was comparable between group care and individual care.
